subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When an invoking host starts one isolated impl-review process execution, that execution and every blind pass context beneath it shall receive no proposal-write credential or canonical evidence-store write capability; each pass context shall return only its pass terminal to the impl-review orchestrator, and only after FR-26 forms the process aggregate shall the outer execution return exactly one completed aggregate through a bounded one-way handoff to the host persistence adapter.
rationale: pass blindness and aggregate ownership stay intact while every reviewer execution context remains unable to manufacture proposal evidence
fit_criterion: critical fixtures show two blind pass outputs reaching only the orchestrator and one later aggregate handoff; capability inspection finds no proposal/evidence-store write authority in the outer execution or pass contexts; zero, malformed, and surplus aggregate handoffs publish nothing
